title: aspidium beddomei
intro: Aspidium beddomei, commonly known as Indian maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions, due to its antiseptic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium beddomei include its use in treating fever, cough, and bronchitis, as well as its ability to improve digestion and relieve menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium beddomei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
